model: c in {0,1,2}^22, sum(c)<=11; candidates may remain unassigned
block_order: existing results.json order: b ascending, then a ascending
within_block_order: uint64 code strictly ascending: mask2 colex, then mask1 colex in its complement

generation_validation.transfer_policy: Read set bits by ascending target ID; assign canonical M[:a] to one-member targets and M[a:] to two-member targets. All five queries use the same M. Zero-count targets are ignored by the rare mean.
generation_validation.duplicates_impossible: Strict order within each type plus distinct (a,b) popcounts between blocks
generation_validation.completeness: Every disjoint pair of 22-bit masks of popcounts (a,b) is generated once; exact binomial counts and all 42 types exhaust sum(c)<=11
generation_validation.individual_membership_guarantee: Existing all-response mean injection composed with 11-single/55-pair five-query code injection
